# Verdant Sanctum gameplay

**In progress: slice 3 of 7 (the new Rootbound Phase II and Last Bloom, engineering channel) in review.** The owner rejected the Verdant gameplay a third time on 2026-11-20: the shared Verdant base is slop, move visuals linger after the move, and Verdant leans on tells far more than any other boss. Verdant's boss, enemies and stage are rebuilt from scratch in the pattern of Aldric, the Echo and the Colossus, keeping only the approved Rootbound seed-pod figure and the drawn background. Measured on main 6fb1a7cd: a scripted player takes 2.8, 1.1 and 0 hits per 10 s from today's Rootbound across its three phases, against 4 to 7 from the reference bosses; its Phase III does not move; its two phase cinematics block 12.9 s of a 37 s fight; it draws 16 tell marks against Aldric's 6. The plan adds two rules over every boss and enemy (nothing outlives its move, tell weight) and builds the new Verdant on the engineering channel until the owner approves it on preview.

- Next: Slice 2 merged as #381 (ruleset v20). Slice 3 merges: Second Swing, Root Seam and its cut, Bramble Rows, Mend and Last Bloom, ruleset v21. Then slice 4, its Phase III; the plan's 6.1 is the handoff.
- Owner action: none
